scripts.dev:desktop: wait-on dist/renderer/index.html dist/electron/main.js dist/electron/preload.cjs && electron dist/electron/main.js
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && git diff --check
scripts.quality: pnpm lint && pnpm quality:unused && pnpm quality:duplicates
scripts.test:browser-smoke: pnpm exec node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run electron/runtime/browser-smoke.test.ts
scripts.acceptance:local: pnpm build:electron && report_path=$(node dist/scripts/run-acceptance.js --lane localFixture --output-dir .acceptance/local) && node dist/scripts/verify-acceptance-report.js "$report_path"
scripts.test: pnpm exec node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --exclude electron/runtime/browser-smoke.test.ts --exclude electron/runtime/suite-benchmark.test.ts && pnpm exec node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run electron/runtime/suite-benchmark.test.ts -t "100-Case" --testTimeout=120000 && pnpm exec node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run electron/runtime/suite-benchmark.test.ts -t "^(?!.*100-Case).*$" --testTimeout=120000
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
